validation_source: Read-only DAX against the open Power BI Desktop model

totals.query: EVALUATE ROW("Countries", [Countries], "Medals", [Total Medals], "Athletes", [Athletes], "Teams", [Team Entries], "Medal Countries", [Medal Countries], "Efficiency", [Medals per 100 Athletes], "Gold Share", [Gold Share])

countries.query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(CountryResults[country], "Medals", [Total Medals], "Gold", [Gold Medals], "Silver", [Silver Medals], "Bronze", [Bronze Medals], "Athletes", [Athletes], "Teams", [Team Entries], "Efficiency", [Medals per 100 Athletes], "Gold Share", [Gold Share], "Rank", [Medal Rank in Selection], "TopTotal", [Total Top Countries])

selection.query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(ROW("Countries", [Countries], "Medals", [Total Medals], "Athletes", [Athletes], "Teams", [Team Entries], "Medal Countries", [Medal Countries], "Efficiency", [Medals per 100 Athletes], "Gold Share", [Gold Share]), CountryResults[country] IN {"India", "United States of America"})

empty.query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(ROW("Countries", [Countries], "Medals", [Total Medals], "Efficiency", [Medals per 100 Athletes], "Gold Share", [Gold Share]), CountryResults[country] = "No such delegation")
